wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a blank ruled sheet, no ink in any band. Cover line 1 prints '-0-' in all three columns, so the scopes coincide and zero rows closes both.

expenditures.detail: ⚠ SCOPE TEST MATTERED ON THIS FILING AND THE COLUMNS ARE NOT THE USUAL ONES. The one inked Form B row (326.15, the March 2010 filing fee) equals the CUMULATIVE cell (326.15) and the TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT cell (326.15); the TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT cell is an EMPTY ruled line. So this is a LATER report of the cycle in which nothing new was spent, and the schedule is carried CUMULATIVELY: the row is a prior-period transaction restated. Scored against the cumulative cell -> scope 'cumulative'. Scoring it against the (blank) THIS cell would have manufactured a false mismatch.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints no schedule or page total. p2 rows 0.00 = cover line 1 '-0-'. p3 row 326.15 = cover line 3 CUMULATIVE 326.15 (the THIS cell is blank; see the scope note). Gates exactly against the matching-scope figure.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3: ok, 1684x2195, 36 data bands, pitch ~2.30%; band 1 carries the row and its wrapped second line ('Clerk') bleeds into band 2, which holds NO separate transaction; bands 2-36 hold no amount -> 1 row emitted. rowbands.py p2: ok, 1695x2195, 36 bands, none inked -> 0 rows. Wrapped-name bleed checked explicitly against the field-shift screen: the continuation line carries NO DIGITS, so it is a wrapped payee name and not a street address.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 first-row crop at 600 dpi (-x 200 -y 590 -W 4600 -H 260) renders the full row 'March 2010 | Cache County / Clerk | Filing Fee | $326.15' including the wrapped second line; the control one pitch below over the amount column (-x 4150 -y 790 -W 700 -H 140) renders EMPTY. Row index unshifted.
gates.balance_chain: ⚠ MAGNITUDE CLOSES, SIGN DOES NOT, AND THE DISCREPANCY IS THE FILER'S. Cover line 4 prints 326.15 in the LAST and CUMULATIVE columns with THIS blank. The arithmetic residual is 0 contributions - 326.15 expenses = -326.15; the filer wrote the magnitude WITHOUT the minus sign. Two other filers in this same chunk on the identical form and the identical 326.15 fee (Zollinger, Howell) wrote '-326.15' in that cell, which is what makes this readable as a dropped sign rather than a different fact. Both figures retained verbatim; nothing recomputed. CROSS-FILING CHAIN: cover line 3's TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT cell (326.15) asserts an earlier report in the same cycle; that earlier filing is NOT in this chunk, so the chain could not be run against it and is reported as untested, not as closed.

escalation_note: p3 row band re-rendered full width at 600 dpi (confirming the wrapped 'Clerk' line and the '$' prefix on the amount); cover lines 3 and 4 re-rendered at 600 dpi, which is what established that the 326.15 sits in the LAST and CUMULATIVE columns with THIS genuinely blank — the fact the whole scope decision turns on, and one that is NOT reliably visible at 100 dpi.
